title: Fish Cakes

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: After the regatta, everyone's invited to supper: my famous fish cakes!

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: The flour must be weighed just right. Will you balance the scales?

steps.speaker: finn
steps.prompt: Add scoops of flour until the beam hangs level.
steps.hint: Is the beam tipping? Add a scoop, or take one out.

feedback.heavy: Too much! Take a scoop out.
feedback.all_good: Level! Now we mix, and shape, and fry.

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: Smell that! Golden fish cakes for everyone who raced, and everyone who cheered.

journal_line: I weighed the flour for Mr. Finn's fish cakes.
